known_interactions: Warfarin (may slightly increase INR with chronic high doses)
med_dolo_650.warnings: Do not exceed 4000mg per 24 hours. Overdose causes severe, potentially fatal liver damage. Avoid taking other paracetamol-containing combination drugs simultaneously.
med_dolo_650.storage_info: Store below 30°C in a dry place. Protect from moisture and direct sunlight.
med_dolo_650.source: Indian Pharmacopoeia (IP) / CDSCO Verified Drug Directory

known_interactions: Iodinated radiocontrast agents (risk of lactic acidosis - withhold 48h)
med_glycomet_500.warnings: Take with meals to reduce gastrointestinal upset. Rare risk of lactic acidosis in patients with significant renal impairment.
med_glycomet_500.storage_info: Store at controlled room temperature (20°C to 25°C). Keep out of reach of children.
med_glycomet_500.source: CDSCO / Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation

indications: Cardiovascular risk reduction in high-risk patients
contraindications: Pregnancy (2nd and 3rd trimesters - causes fetal toxicity)
known_interactions: Potassium-sparing diuretics & Potassium supplements (risk of hyperkalemia)
med_telma_40.warnings: Monitor serum potassium and renal function periodically. Do not discontinue abruptly without physician consultation.
med_telma_40.storage_info: Store in the original moisture-resistant blister pack below 30°C.
med_telma_40.source: CDSCO / National List of Essential Medicines (NLEM)

contraindications: History of amoxicillin/clavulanate-associated jaundice or hepatic dysfunction
med_augmentin_625.warnings: Complete full prescribed course to prevent antimicrobial resistance. Discontinue immediately if allergic rash or anaphylaxis occurs.
med_augmentin_625.storage_info: Store in a cool, dry place below 25°C protected from moisture.

known_interactions: Ketoconazole / Itraconazole (decreased absorption due to increased pH)
med_pan_40.warnings: Best taken 30 to 60 minutes before breakfast. Swallow whole, do not crush or chew.
med_pan_40.storage_info: Store protected from moisture and light at temperature not exceeding 30°C.

indications: Prevention of cardiovascular events in coronary artery disease
contraindications: Active liver disease / unexplained persistent elevation of serum transaminases
med_atorva_20.warnings: Report unexplained muscle pain, tenderness, or weakness promptly (risk of rhabdomyolysis).
med_atorva_20.storage_info: Store below 25°C in a dry place.
